selection: PG2 m0.83 schedule chosen using previous canonical evaluation. New reset blocks evaluate the already-frozen three policies; this is not independent training-seed validation.
evaluation_units: 3 fixed training seeds x3 execution settings x6 new blocks x104 serial episodes

primary_joint_gate.hard_bound: one-sided exact binomial, alpha=0.05/3 per fixed policy (Bonferroni simultaneous across the 3 primary policies)

comparisons: Paired native/random controls on identical checkpoint, reset seeds and blocks. Report all per-seed reward/risk/soft-cost changes; no universal superiority claim.
stopping_rule: Evaluate the fixed total irrespective of intermediate scores. No added blocks, parameter changes, early success stop, or outcome-selected retries. Failures remain missing with receipts.
limits: Safety inference conditional on tested fixed policies and simulator reset distribution.
Soft budget and mean return gates are empirical; report uncertainty separately.
No zero-risk, SOTA, physical irreversible safety, or new-training-seed claim.
